title: Zigzag Iterator
description: Iterate through two vectors in zigzag order using a queue of iterators.
pseudocode:
1: queue = [v1.begin(), v2.begin()]
2: while queue is not empty:
3:   it = queue.shift()
4:   if it != end:
5:     val = *it
6:     queue.push(next(it))
7:     return val

steps.note: Initialize queue with iterators for both arrays.
Pop first iterator, get value 1 from first array.
Push next iterator of first array back to queue.
Pop second iterator, get value 4 from second array.
Push next iterator of second array back to queue.
